Quo has no call log in its connector. Answered means incoming calls that have a transcript, and outbound means outgoing calls that have a transcript, so both are lower bounds. Missed calls are complete.
Whether a call back reached a person or a voicemail is estimated from the first 45 seconds of the transcript.
Calls per person outside Oct 8 to 11 are matched from the name the agent says on the call; about one call in eight has no name and is listed as unattributed.
